meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页打磨得更美观、更规范,同时兼顾性能与无障碍。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常做前端界面调整,却不太确定设计是否好看。
copy.tagline_en: Polish web pages to be more elegant, consistent, and accessible.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often tweak frontend interfaces but are unsure about design taste.

howto.what: 做网页或界面设计时,Claude 会先按内置规则挑参考,先写出 DESIGN.md 设计契约,再照着做页面或组件,并用真实浏览器检查性能和外观。
howto.when: 当你提到 frontend、UI/UX、design 等关键词,或要求做改版、动效、性能优化等前端相关工作时触发。

say.text: 按 Stripe 的风格重做这个落地页,先建 DESIGN.md。
say.note: 会先读取品牌参考并产出设计契约。

say.text: 用真实浏览器跑 Lighthouse,性能每个类别都到 100。
say.note: 用 Playwright 驱动浏览器审计并报告。

say.text: 查一下这个项目应该用什么配色和字体搭配。
say.note: 会从 UI 数据库检索并给出建议。

howto.what_en: On frontend/UI work, Claude routes to built-in rules, requires a DESIGN.md contract, then builds and checks performance & appearance in a real browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "frontend", "UI/UX", "design", or ask for redesign, animation, performance optimization, or other frontend-related work.

say_en.text: Redo this landing page in Stripe's style, create DESIGN.md first.
say_en.note: Reads the brand reference and produces a design contract.

say_en.text: Run Lighthouse in a real browser and get 100 in every performance category.
say_en.note: Audits with Playwright Chromium and reports results.

say_en.text: Look up the color palette and font pairing this project should use.
say_en.note: Searches the UI database and suggests a palette.
